events.title: V28 Update
events.summary: 1. System Overhaul, AI & Enemy Mechanics UpdateThe Corruption System has been reworked into the Sanity System. Players may now spend Sanity to sign Pacts and gain advantages during card battles — but beware, enemies can use them too.A discard system has been added. Players can now voluntarily discard their hand to proactively avoid risks.AI can now use Pacts and discard cards just like players, with deeper decision-making logic.Mechanics for enemies including the Wizard, Red Hand, Phantom, Snake
